task.title: How This Topic Maintains Itself: A Self-Referential DITA Task
task.shortdesc: This topic demonstrates how to create, structure, and maintain a DITA task topic about itself, including DITA best practices and reuse.

step.cmd: Review the topic structure: This file uses the DITA task topic type, with title, shortdesc, prolog, and taskbody elements.
Notice content reuse: The safety warning is reused from safety_notice.dita using a conref. To update the warning, edit the source topic.
Understand audience filtering: Steps are tailored for different regions using the audience attribute. To add a new region, duplicate a step and set audience accordingly.
Maintain keyrefs: This topic uses keyref for region-specific standards. Update keys in the DITA map to change referenced standards globally.
To extend this topic: Add new steps, reuse content with conref, or add new audience attributes for additional regions.
Validate changes: After editing, run the DITA-OT validator to ensure the topic is well-formed and references resolve correctly.
